newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rocked by quake measuring 5 on Richter scale.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rocked by quake measuring 5 on Richter scale.

text.p: A strong earthquake measuring 5.0 on the Richter scale shook homes and offices in Tokyo on Wednesday, but there were no immediate indications of damage or casualties, the Meteorological Agency reported.
The agency said the epicentre of the quake was 80 km (50 miles) underground in Chiba prefecture which borders the Tokyo metropolitan area.
The quake happened at 6.36 p.m. (0936 GMT).
Residents of the capital said the tremor was the strongest they had felt for many months, and a quake with a magnitude of five on the Richter scale could cause considerable damage.
All national television networks flashed news of the quake during their main evening broadcasts.
